repos.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,DeepSeek Harness and more. Only official website: ccswitch.io
repos.summary_zh: CC Switch是基于Tauri 2的跨平台桌面应用，为Claude Code、Codex和Gemini CLI提供统一管理平台。该工具解决开发者在多AI编程助手间切换的痛点，集成API中继服务配置，支持Windows、macOS和Linux系统。具备轻量级、高安全性特点，可显著提升AI辅助开发效率，实现一站式AI编码环境管理。
repos.summary_en: CC Switch is a cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri 2 that unifies management of AI coding assistants including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It eliminates workflow fragmentation by centralizing API relay configurations and model switching in a single interface. The lightweight, secure app runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, streamlining AI-powered development and boosting developer productivity through consolidated tool management.

repos.description: The 1st Collaborative AI Design Agent Workspace. Local-first and open source. Create motion, prototypes, websites, apps, dashboards, presentations, images, and videos with your team and AI agents. Share work, exchange feedback, and iterate together in one workspace.
repos.summary_zh: Open Design 是开源、本地优先的 Claude Design 替代品，支持 16+ AI 编码代理（Claude Code/Cursor/Gemini 等）。提供 31 种可组合技能和 72 个品牌级设计系统，可生成 Web/桌面/移动原型、幻灯片、图像和视频，支持 HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 导出。BYOK 模式确保数据自主，沙盒预览保障安全，是 Figma 的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open Design is an open-source, local-first alternative to Claude Design supporting 16+ AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, etc.). It offers 31 composable skills and 72 brand-grade design systems to generate web, desktop, and mobile prototypes, slides, images, and videos. Features include sandboxed preview, HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 export, and BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model for data sovereignty. A viable open-source replacement for Figma with multi-agent flexibility.

repos.description: Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with one command, on macOS, Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: Pake 是一款基于 Rust Tauri 的轻量级桌面应用打包工具，可将任意网页转化为独立原生应用。相比 Electron 应用体积缩小约 20 倍，仅 5MB 左右，内存占用更低且运行更快。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 三大平台，提供 CLI 命令行一键打包和在线构建服务。内置快捷键、沉浸式窗口、样式定制、广告过滤等功能，已预打包微信读书、Twitter、Grok、DeepSeek 等常用应用。
repos.summary_en: Pake is a lightweight desktop app packaging tool built with Rust Tauri that converts any webpage into a native standalone application. It reduces package size by approximately 20x compared to Electron (around 5MB), with faster performance and lower memory usage. Supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux, it offers one-command packaging via CLI and online building. Features include keyboard shortcuts, immersive windows, style customization, and ad removal. Pre-built packages are available for popular services like WeRead, Twitter, Grok, and DeepSeek.

repos.description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.
repos.summary_zh: Voicebox 是一款开源本地AI语音工作室，提供语音克隆、多语言TTS和全局听写功能。支持7大引擎、23种语言，零样本克隆声音，具备后处理与表达性控制。完全离线运行保障隐私，集成故事编辑器与AI代理语音交互，是 ElevenLabs 与 WisprFlow 的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Voicebox is an open-source, local-first AI voice studio that enables voice cloning from seconds of audio and speech generation in 23 languages across 7 TTS engines. It provides zero-shot voice cloning, expressive speech with paralinguistic tags, post-processing effects, and unlimited-length content creation. Key features include global dictation hotkeys, multi-track timeline editing for podcasts, and voice-enabled AI agent interaction via local LLM integration. Running entirely offline ensures complete privacy, making it a comprehensive free alternative to ElevenLabs and WisprFlow.

repos.description: Your AI workspace for models, agents, and productivity.
repos.summary_zh: Cherry Studio 是一款 AI 生产力桌面应用，集成智能聊天与自主代理能力，内置 300+ 专业助手。通过统一接口无缝接入 GPT-4、Claude 等前沿大模型，支持多语言交互与上下文感知，覆盖文档处理、代码生成、研究分析等场景，实现智能化升级并显著提升工作效率。
repos.summary_en: Cherry Studio is a comprehensive AI productivity desktop application that seamlessly integrates intelligent chat interfaces with autonomous agent capabilities, featuring over 300 specialized assistants for various domains. The platform provides unified access to leading large language models including GPT-4 and Claude, supports multilingual interactions with advanced context awareness, enables intelligent automation across document processing, code generation, and research analysis scenarios, and offers a user-friendly interface for both technical and non-technical users, significantly enhancing workplace productivity and operational efficiency through streamlined workflows.

repos.description: The Open-Source Multimodal AI Agent Stack: Connecting Cutting-Edge AI Models and Agent Infra
repos.summary_zh: UI-TARS-desktop是字节跳动开源的多模态AI智能体桌面应用，基于UI-TARS视觉模型实现GUI自动化操作。支持本地与远程计算机及浏览器控制，无缝集成MCP工具链，通过自然语言指令完成跨应用任务。提供CLI与Web UI双模式，具备流式响应、运行时调试和沙箱隔离等企业级特性，为生产力自动化提供端到端解决方案。
repos.summary_en: UI-TARS-desktop is ByteDance's open-source multimodal AI agent desktop application powered by the UI-TARS vision model for GUI automation. It enables local and remote control of computers and browsers through natural language commands, seamlessly integrating with MCP tools for human-like task completion. Offering both CLI and Web UI interfaces, it features streaming responses, runtime performance statistics, Event Stream Viewer for debugging, and AIO Sandbox isolation. This enterprise-ready stack delivers a complete end-to-end solution for automating productivity workflows across desktop and web environments.

repos.description: Create polished demo videos without editing skills. Mac/Windows/Linux
repos.summary_zh: Recordly 是一款开源跨平台的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为产品演示、教程视频等场景设计。其核心亮点在于自动化后期处理：智能缩放、光标美化、动态摄像头叠加和样式化边框，无需专业剪辑即可生成 polished 视频。采用原生捕获技术（ScreenCaptureKit/WGC）保证性能，支持扩展插件，实现录制到编辑的一体化工作流。
repos.summary_en: Recordly is an open-source, cross-platform screen recorder and editor designed for product demos, tutorials, and walkthroughs. It automates post-production with AI-powered zoom suggestions, cursor polish, dynamic webcam overlays, and styled frames—eliminating manual editing. Built on native capture backends (ScreenCaptureKit/WGC) for performance, it features an extensible plugin system and seamless record-to-edit workflow.

repos.description: Uncensored Open-source alternative to AI video platforms — Free AI image & video generation studio with 800+ models (Flux, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Veo). No content filters. Self-hosted, MIT licensed.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI媒体生成工作室，集成200+先进模型（Flux、Sora、Kling等），提供无过滤的图像视频创作环境。支持自托管与跨平台桌面应用，通过AI编码代理实现提示→生成→编辑→合成的全流程自动化，是商业AI平台的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open-source AI media generation studio integrating 200+ state-of-the-art models (Flux, Sora, Kling) for unfiltered image/video creation. Features self-hosting, cross-platform desktop apps, and AI agent automation for end-to-end media pipeline orchestration. MIT-licensed alternative to commercial platforms.

repos.description: :rocket: The Ultimate Image Uploader for Efficient Creators. Supports Obsidian, Typora, VS Code etc. and 60+ image hosting services  (S3, GitHub, Cloudflare R2, Imgur, Aliyun OSS...). Paste, upload, done.
repos.summary_zh: PicGo是专为创作者设计的终极图片上传工具，无缝集成Obsidian、VS Code、Typora等主流编辑器。支持60+图床服务（GitHub、阿里云OSS、S3等），通过拖拽/粘贴/快捷键实现秒传并自动复制链接。独创插件系统可扩展支持Cloudflare R2等新兴存储，彻底消除写作中的上下文切换，让创作者专注内容生产。
repos.summary_en: PicGo is the ultimate image uploader for efficient creators, seamlessly integrating with Obsidian, VS Code, Typora and other editors. Supporting 60+ image hosts (GitHub, Alibaba Cloud OSS, AWS S3), it enables instant uploads via drag-and-drop/clipboard/hotkeys with auto-copied links. Its extensible plugin system adds support for Cloudflare R2 and more, eliminating context switching to maximize creative focus.

repos.description: Readest is a modern, feature-rich ebook reader designed for avid readers offering seamless cross-platform access, powerful tools, and an intuitive interface to elevate your reading experience.
repos.summary_zh: Readest 是一款基于 Next.js 16 和 Tauri v2 构建的开源电子书阅读器，覆盖桌面、移动及 Web 全平台。支持 EPUB/MOBI/AZW3 等主流格式，提供分屏并行阅读、代码语法高亮、全文检索与智能笔记等深度功能，专为追求沉浸式体验的深度阅读者打造。
repos.summary_en: Readest is a modern, open-source ebook reader engineered for immersive reading experiences. Leveraging Next.js 16 and Tauri v2, it delivers native performance across macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and web platforms. Supporting EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ, TXT, and experimental PDF formats, it features split-screen parallel reading, code syntax highlighting, full-text search, dictionary lookup, and comprehensive annotation tools. Built as a sophisticated rewrite of Foliate, Readest combines powerful library management with customizable reading settings to serve avid readers and technical professionals.

repos.description: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base — automatically. Instead of traditional RAG (retrieve-and-answer from scratch every time), the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources。
repos.summary_zh: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，采用增量编译模式构建自组织知识库，颠覆传统RAG每次查询重检索的机制。核心亮点包括：双阶段思维链文档摄入、多模态图像理解、四信号知识图谱、Louvain社区发现，以及本地API支持AI智能体调用。实现文档自动结构化为可追溯、可探索的互联知识网络。
repos.summary_en: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop app that incrementally builds a persistent, self-organizing knowledge base from documents—compiling knowledge once instead of re-deriving on every query like traditional RAG. Key features include two-step Chain-of-Thought ingestion, multimodal image understanding, 4-signal knowledge graph, Louvain community detection, and local API for AI agent integration. Automatically transforms documents into interconnected, explorable knowledge networks with source traceability.

repos.description: SimpleX - the first messaging network operating without user identifiers of any kind - 100% private by design! iOS, Android and desktop apps 📱!
repos.summary_zh: SimpleX Chat是首个无任何用户标识符的消息平台，100%隐私设计，保护消息内容及元数据（通话对象与时间）。采用SMP协议通过单向匿名队列实现去中心化通信，支持用户自建服务器。具备双棘轮E2EE加密、多层防护、带外密钥交换、群组通话等功能。提供iOS、Android、桌面及CLI跨平台应用，适用于隐私敏感用户防范监控与垃圾信息场景。技术亮点包括便携加密存储和Tor支持。
repos.summary_en: SimpleX is the first messaging network operating without any user identifiers whatsoever, providing 100% privacy by design through protection of both message content and metadata. Built on the SimpleX Messaging Protocol (SMP), it uses unidirectional queues with pairwise anonymous addresses for decentralized, server-relayed communication where anyone can host servers. It features double-ratchet end-to-end encryption augmented with additional layers, out-of-band key exchange via links or QR codes, support for encrypted groups, calls, files, and optional Tor access. Cross-platform apps for iOS, Android, desktop, and terminal CLI enable portable encrypted data storage. Ideal for users prioritizing metadata privacy and spam resistance in secure communications.

repos.description: The most intuitive desktop API client. Organize and execute REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Server Sent Events, and gRPC 🦬
repos.summary_zh: Yaak 是一款隐私优先的跨平台桌面 API 客户端，全面支持 REST、GraphQL、WebSocket、SSE 和 gRPC 协议。基于 Tauri 框架构建，后端采用 Rust 实现高性能与安全性，前端使用 React 提供流畅交互。通过社区许可模式运营，为开发者提供直观、高效的 API 调试与管理解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Yaak is a privacy-first cross-platform desktop API client supporting REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE, and gRPC protocols. Built on Tauri framework with Rust backend and React frontend, it delivers high-performance API debugging experience. Community-funded through license purchases, it offers intuitive interface for developers to organize, test, and manage APIs efficiently.

repos.description: 📻Free and open-sourced terminal/ssh/sftp/ftp/telnet/serialport/RDP/VNC/Spice client(Linux, Mac, Windows, Android, HarmonyOS, iOS)
repos.summary_zh: electerm 是一款开源的跨平台终端与远程连接客户端，集成 SSH/SFTP/FTP/Telnet/串口/RDP/VNC 等多种协议。支持 Windows、macOS、Linux（含 ARM64），提供全局热键、透明窗口、背景图片等特性。内置 AI 助手（DeepSeek/OpenAI）与 MCP 协议支持，实现命令建议与工具集成。通过 Zmodem/Trzsz 实现文件传输，并可将配置同步至 GitHub/Gitee Gist，是开发者管理远程服务器的全能工具。
repos.summary_en: electerm is an open-source, cross-platform terminal and remote connection client that consolidates SSH, SFTP, FTP, Telnet, serial port, RDP, VNC, and Spice protocols into a single application. Built on Electron, it supports Windows, macOS, and Linux (including ARM64 architectures). Key features include global hotkeys for instant access, transparent windows, terminal background images, and integrated AI assistants (DeepSeek, OpenAI) via MCP protocol for command suggestions and script generation. It facilitates file transfers through Zmodem and Trzsz, supports SSH tunneling and proxy configurations, and allows synchronization of bookmarks and settings to GitHub/Gitee Gist, making it a versatile tool for developers and system administrators managing remote infrastructure.

repos.description: Plan, run and supervise fleets of agents from task to merged PR. Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) + iPhone & Android apps.  Supports Claude Code, Codex & 35+ coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Orchestrator 是一款跨平台桌面应用，用于统一编排和监督多个编码 AI 智能体（支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 25+ 工具）。每个任务独立分配智能体、隔离工作区和 Git 分支，通过实时看板追踪 PR、CI 和评审全流程，实现从规划到合并的自动化协作开发。
repos.summary_en: Agent Orchestrator is a cross-platform desktop workspace for orchestrating and supervising teams of coding AI agents from planning to merge. It supports 25+ agent harnesses including Claude Code and Codex. Each task gets its own agent, isolated workspace, and dedicated Git branch. A live Kanban board tracks workers, pull requests, CI runs, and code reviews in real time. A local daemon monitors agent activity and source-control state, providing a unified project view instead of disconnected terminals and branches. It enables efficient parallel development across multiple coding agents.

repos.description: A free, open-source Windows desktop organizer with native-feeling WinUI 3 widgets.
repos.summary_zh: DeskBox是一款免费开源的Windows桌面整理工具，基于WinUI 3和.NET 10 Native AOT构建，提供原生质感的桌面小组件，支持文件整理、待办、搜索、天气和音乐控制等。它采用本地优先存储，不改变现有文件结构，支持Mica和Acrylic材质，兼容x64和ARM64，提供13种语言界面，是Stardock Fences的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: DeskBox is a free, open-source Windows desktop organizer built with WinUI 3 and .NET 10 Native AOT, offering native-feeling desktop widgets for file organization, todos, search, weather, and music controls. It is local-first, preserves existing file structures, supports Mica and Acrylic materials, works on x64 and ARM64, and provides 13 languages, serving as an open-source alternative to Stardock Fences.

repos.description: Easy and blazing-fast book searcher, create and search your private library.
repos.summary_zh: 极速图书搜索引擎，支持创建私有书库。一分钟索引超1000万图书元数据，检索响应仅30微秒。提供跨平台桌面应用、命令行工具及Web API，支持Docker、Vercel/Netlify部署，可按字段精准搜索。
repos.summary_en: Ultra-fast book search engine for private libraries. Indexes 10M+ books/min, searches in 30µs. Cross-platform desktop, CLI, Web API. Docker/Vercel support.

repos.description: Open-source, desktop-grade AI agent that gets real work done — data analysis, slides, docs, video & web research. Built on OpenClaw; runs tools on your real desktop and takes commands from your phone via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk & Telegram.
repos.summary_zh: 网易有道推出的LobsterAI是一款24/7全场景AI个人助理，基于Electron+React构建跨平台桌面应用。核心采用Cowork模式，支持本地或Alpine沙盒环境执行任务，内置Office文档生成、Playwright自动化、Remotion视频生成等技能。通过Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu实现移动端远程控制，具备持久化记忆与权限审批机制，覆盖数据分析、PPT制作、邮件处理等办公场景。
repos.summary_en: LobsterAI by NetEase Youdao is a 24/7 all-scenario AI personal assistant built on Electron+React. Its core Cowork mode executes tasks in local or Alpine sandbox environments, featuring built-in skills like Office document generation, Playwright automation, and Remotion video creation. It enables remote control via IM platforms (Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu), persistent memory, permission gating, and covers productivity scenarios including data analysis, presentation creation, and email management.

repos.description: Turn your Telegram account into an unlimited, secure cloud storage drive. an Open-source desktop app built with Tauri, Rust, and React.
repos.summary_zh: Telegram Drive是一款开源跨平台桌面应用，利用Telegram API将账号转化为无限安全的云存储驱动。基于Tauri、Rust和React构建，提供熟悉的文件资源管理器界面，支持Saved Messages和Channels作为文件夹。核心亮点包括高性能虚拟滚动、媒体流式播放、内置PDF查看器、拖放上传、密码保护分享链接、本地REST API支持AI集成、代理及VPN优化。隐私优先，数据与密钥本地存储，无第三方服务器。兼容Windows、macOS、Linux及Android平台。
repos.summary_en: Telegram Drive is an open-source cross-platform desktop app that turns your Telegram account into unlimited, secure cloud storage. Built with Tauri, Rust, and React, it provides a familiar file explorer using Saved Messages and Channels as folders. Highlights include high-performance virtual scrolling, media streaming, built-in PDF viewer, drag-and-drop, password-protected shareable links, local REST API for AI integration, proxy/VPN optimization, and privacy focus with all data local and no third-party servers. Supports Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.

repos.description: The Librum client application
repos.summary_zh: Librum 是一款基于 Qt 框架构建的开源跨平台电子书阅读与管理应用，核心价值在于融合个人数字图书馆与云同步能力。支持 EPUB 等格式，提供笔记、高亮、AI 辅助工具及深度界面定制，可自托管实现多设备无缝访问。集成 70,000+ 免费书籍资源，以现代化交互设计和隐私优先架构，为追求个性化与可控性的数字阅读者提供一体化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Librum is an open-source, cross-platform e-book reader built on Qt framework that merges personal digital library management with cloud synchronization. It offers note-taking, highlighting, AI-powered tools, and deep UI customization, supporting self-hosting for multi-device access. Featuring 70,000+ free books and a modern interface, it delivers a privacy-focused, all-in-one reading solution for users seeking personalized digital literacy experiences.

repos.description: On-device subtitle generation that connects directly to DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, and After Effects.
repos.summary_zh: AutoSubs 是一款基于 Tauri 框架的跨平台 AI 字幕生成工具，本地运行 Whisper 等模型实现高精度语音转录。支持说话人分离、多语言翻译，可导出 SRT 或直接导入 DaVinci Resolve 进行高级样式定制。无需云端订阅，保障数据隐私，为视频创作者提供高效、可定制的自动化字幕解决方案。
repos.summary_en: AutoSubs is a cross-platform desktop application that generates AI-powered subtitles locally on user devices without cloud dependencies. Built on Tauri framework with React frontend and Rust backend, it leverages state-of-the-art models including Whisper, Parakeet and Pyannote for accurate transcription, speaker diarization and translation. The tool offers one-click export to SRT or direct integration with DaVinci Resolve, featuring per-speaker styling and real-time editing capabilities. Designed for video creators and post-production professionals, it delivers privacy-preserving, efficient subtitle workflows with full customization options.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg 是多智能体 AI 编程协作工作区，统一聚合 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build 等十余种 AI 编码代理，支持跨代理会话迁移与 @ 委派协作，提供桌面端、自托管服务器、Docker 及移动端全平台部署，让多个 AI 代理在同一结构化界面中协同完成开发任务。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace that unifies 15+ AI coding agents—Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and more—into a single structured conversation interface with live diffs and project file browsing. It supports cross-agent session import, search, and transfer, plus @-delegation for inter-agent task collaboration in isolated worktrees. Deployable as a desktop app, self-hosted server, Docker container, or mobile apps for iOS and Android, with integrations for Telegram, Lark, and WeChat for remote access.

repos.description: Translate full-length books and documents with Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Poe or OpenRouter. Preserves formatting. Resumes where you left off. No file size limits.
repos.summary_zh: 该桌面应用利用Ollama、OpenAI、Gemini等LLM翻译书籍、字幕和文档，支持EPUB、SRT、DOCX、TXT格式。智能分块处理任意长度文件，严格保留格式、样式与结构，支持断点续传。提供本地隐私部署与云端API选项，跨平台易用，适合长篇内容多语言处理与本地化场景。
repos.summary_en: TranslateBooksWithLLMs is a cross-platform desktop app that leverages LLMs like local Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini and others to translate full-length books, subtitles and documents. It supports EPUB, SRT, DOCX and TXT formats with perfect preservation of structure and styling, uses intelligent chunking for unlimited file sizes while maintaining context, and features automatic checkpoints for resuming translations. Offers both offline local processing and cloud APIs via a simple local web interface.

repos.description: Fast, native Rust + GPUI workspace for local and SSH with MCP tools—no WebView, no telemetry, open source.
repos.summary_zh: OxideTerm 是一款基于 Tauri 2 和纯 Rust SSH 实现的一体化终端工作台，将本地 Shell、SSH、SFTP、远程 IDE 和 AI 代理集成于单一原生二进制文件中。其核心技术亮点包括智能重连、连接复用、MCP 协议与 RAG 知识库的 AI 集成，以及无 Electron、无 OpenSSL 的轻量化架构，为开发者和运维人员提供高效、稳定的跨平台远程开发体验。
repos.summary_en: OxideTerm is an all-in-one terminal workspace built with Tauri 2 and pure Rust SSH, integrating local shells, SSH, SFTP, remote IDE, and AI agent into a single native binary. Key technical highlights include smart reconnection, connection multiplexing, MCP protocol with RAG-based AI integration, and a lightweight architecture without Electron or OpenSSL, delivering efficient and stable cross-platform remote development experience for developers and operations teams.

repos.description: Free, open-source anti-detect browser launcher for web scraping and multi-accounting. By the ShardX team (formerly ProxyShard). Engine-level fingerprint spoofing in Chromium 158 (WebGL / WebGPU / Client Hints / fonts / TLS), 220+ device profiles bundled, stable QUIC + WebRTC over SOCKS5.
repos.summary_zh: ShardX 是开源反检测浏览器启动器，基于修改版 Chromium 152 引擎实现多层指纹伪装，内置 220+ 设备配置，支持 SOCKS5 代理下 QUIC/WebRTC，提供多语言 SDK 与 MCP 服务，适用于网页爬虫与多账号管理。
repos.summary_en: ShardX is a free, open-source anti-detect browser launcher built on a patched Chromium 152 engine with deep fingerprint spoofing across WebGL, WebGPU, Client Hints, fonts, and TLS layers. It bundles 220+ device profiles, supports stable QUIC and WebRTC over SOCKS5 proxies, and provides multi-language SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Rust along with a local API and MCP server. Designed by the ProxyShard team, it is ideal for web scraping and multi-account management workflows at scale.

repos.description: 把英文论文读成舒服的中文：本地 PDF 论文翻译、原文对照、边读边问 AI、文献管理。Read English papers in comfortable Chinese.
repos.summary_zh: EasyRead 是一款本地论文阅读工具，支持 PDF 翻译、原文对照、边读边问 AI 和文献管理。通过多模型 API 实现舒适的中文阅读，帮助科研人员高效理解英文论文。
repos.summary_en: EasyRead is a local paper reading tool that supports PDF translation, side-by-side comparison, AI Q&A, and reference management. It leverages multiple model APIs to provide comfortable Chinese reading, helping researchers efficiently understand English papers.

repos.description: High-performance native SSH client in Rust, GPU-rendered with GPUI: host manager, terminal, WinSCP-style SFTP and port forwarding. Rust 编写、GPU 渲染的原生 SSH 客户端。
repos.summary_zh: ShellRS 是一款 Rust 编写的高性能跨平台原生 SSH 客户端，基于 GPUI 实现 GPU 渲染界面。集成 Xshell 风格主机管理、WinSCP 风格 SFTP 文件传输及端口转发，支持多级跳板与代理连接，无 Electron 依赖，并提供 CLI 供 AI 智能体调用。
repos.summary_en: ShellRS is a high-performance, cross-platform native SSH client written in Rust, featuring GPU-accelerated rendering powered by the GPUI framework from the Zed editor. It unifies Xshell-style host management, tabbed terminals, WinSCP-style dual-pane SFTP file transfer, and SSH port forwarding into a single integrated window. The client supports multi-level jump hosts, HTTP and SOCKS5 proxy connections, and stores credentials securely in the system keychain. With no Electron or JVM dependencies, it delivers native performance. A built-in CLI tool also enables AI agents like Claude Code to execute commands and transfer files on saved hosts.

repos.description: Use your android phone as windows virtual webcam
repos.summary_zh: VCamdroid 将 Android 手机摄像头转化为 Windows 高性能虚拟摄像头。通过 Softcam 的 DirectShow 滤镜实现与 Zoom、OBS、Teams 等应用的无缝兼容，支持 ADB 有线和 Wi-Fi 无线连接，采用 RTSP 协议、Camera2 API、OpenGL 预处理及硬件编码（H.264/HEVC），提供低延迟视频流。支持多设备切换、相机控制（前后摄、分辨率、闪光灯）及实时图像调整（旋转、翻转、亮度等），适用于视频会议、直播和录制场景。
repos.summary_en: VCamdroid turns your Android phone's camera into a high-performance virtual webcam for Windows. It uses a custom DirectShow filter from the Softcam library for seamless compatibility with Zoom, OBS, Discord, and Teams. Supporting both ADB wired and Wi-Fi wireless connections via RTSP, it delivers low-latency, hardware-accelerated streams using Camera2 API, OpenGL preprocessing, and MediaCodec encoding. Features include multi-device support, full camera controls, and real-time image adjustments, ideal for video calls, streaming, and recording.

repos.description: LinPad — Linux for iPad. A real Linux desktop on the iPad: native windowed desktop with tiling and workspaces, real Linux apps (Firefox, VS Code, Thunar, VLC) as native windows, ARM64 JIT, GPU via Venus/Metal, keyboard + trackpad + touch.
repos.summary_zh: LinPad 将 iPad 变身真实 Linux 桌面，基于 Alpine Linux 与 Wayland 合成器，原生运行 VS Code、Firefox、VLC 等应用，支持窗口平铺、工作区、ARM64 JIT 及 Venus/Metal GPU 加速，无需虚拟机或越狱，一个应用解锁 iPad 完整生产力。
repos.summary_en: LinPad transforms iPad into a real Linux desktop powered by Alpine Linux and Wayland, running native apps like VS Code, Firefox, and VLC with window tiling, workspaces, ARM64 JIT, and Venus/Metal GPU acceleration—no VM or jailbreak needed.

repos.description: Markdown editor that gets out of your way. Lightweight, fast, portable. First release of https://4worlds.dev
repos.summary_zh: Inkwell是基于Rust+Tauri v2构建的轻量级Markdown编辑器，主打离线运行与极速启动（<1秒）。支持Mermaid图表、LaTeX公式、GitHub Flavored Markdown，提供4种主题与专注模式。100%本地存储，零遥测，安装包仅5-12MB。适用于跨平台写作，免费版功能完整，Pro版解锁PDF/HTML导出。
repos.summary_en: Inkwell is a sovereign Markdown editor built with Rust+Tauri v2, delivering <1s startup and offline-first operation. Features Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX math, GitHub Flavored Markdown, 4 themes, focus mode, and version history. 100% local storage, zero telemetry, 5-12MB footprint. Cross-platform for distraction-free writing. Free forever, Pro adds PDF/HTML export.

repos.description: 🤖 An AI-powered desktop automation agent built with Electron &   Next.js - Control your computer like manus, but as a native   desktop app, an ai browser!
repos.summary_zh: 基于Electron与Next.js的AI桌面自动化浏览器，实现类Manus的计算机控制。核心特性：双模式交互（ChatAgent轻量对话/Deep Explore多智能体工作流）、多模态任务执行、可视化定时调度。支持DeepSeek/Qwen/Gemini等AI提供商，集成Tavily/Serper搜索与MCP服务。采用React 19+Zustand架构，提供原生桌面体验，适用于智能办公、研究分析与自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered desktop automation browser built with Electron and Next.js that enables Manus-like computer control through a native application. Key features include dual-mode interaction (ChatAgent for lightweight conversations vs. Deep Explore for multi-agent workflows), multi-modal task execution, and visual scheduling. Supports major AI providers (DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemini, Claude) with integrated search engines (Tavily/Serper) and MCP services. Built on React 19+Zustand architecture, it delivers native desktop experience for intelligent office work, research analysis, and automation scenarios.

repos.description: A modern personal time management and task tracking application
repos.summary_zh: Fates 是一款基于 Tauri 和 Svelte 构建的开源时间管理与任务追踪应用。它通过可视化时间轴、热力图和数据分析帮助用户识别时间黑洞，内置 AI 助手可优化任务描述并自动生成周报。采用本地优先存储策略保障隐私，支持多端同步，旨在解决职场人士时间管理混乱、工作效率低下及周报总结困难等痛点。
repos.summary_en: Fates is a modern open-source time management and task tracking application built with Tauri and Svelte, designed to help professionals combat productivity challenges. It features visual timeline views, GitHub-style calendar heatmaps, and comprehensive data analytics to reveal time consumption patterns. The integrated AI assistant optimizes task descriptions, auto-generates weekly reports, and provides intelligent scheduling suggestions. Employing a local-first storage architecture for privacy protection, it supports seamless synchronization across web and desktop platforms. Fates directly addresses common pain points: disorganized time management, inefficient workflows, and the tedious process of weekly reporting, making it an ideal tool for self-improvement and career development.
